name: Mock Magic OG social card by Mock Magic: Video Presets
description: A 1200×630 social card split into two asymmetric zones: a quiet black left half carrying the wordmark and a two-line white headline, and a dense right half where a laptop, phone and watch stack bleed off the edges. All three screens show the same blue-and-orange painterly artwork, so the product's value (your content on every device) is demonstrated without a single word of explanation. Colour is withheld everywhere except inside the screens, which makes the artwork the only chromatic event and gives the card its pop.
